shots.camera: slow push in toward the bottle
shots.action: A horizontal light beam sweeps upward across a heart-shaped blue perfume bottle labeled YAGI.

look.lighting: Soft studio light from the left casting gentle shadows to the right, with a bright horizontal light flare.
look.palette: Cool light blue and white background, deep blue liquid, white petals.

reading.summary: 이 영상은 5초 길이의 컷 전환이 없는 단일 장면이에요. 카메라는 향수병을 향해 천천히 다가가며, 별도의 소리는 나오지 않아요.

bottle.madeWith: Visual style: Deep sapphire shadow floor, crisp ivory white petals and translucent cobalt glass accented by cool silver mirror reflections. Soft, diffused blue light from camera-left. Shot on a 50mm prime lens with shallow depth of field. 0.0s–5.0s: Off-axis low-angle medium-close shot of the heart-shaped blue YAGI perfume bottle resting among scattered white flower petals in front of an oval mirror. The camera executes a slow, steady dolly-in toward the bottle, drawing focus onto the heart-shaped glass facets and YAGI label. Audio: quiet room ambience, no music.

shots.action: A woman lies on light blue beads surrounded by blue heart-shaped perfume bottles and a white ribbon, blinking slowly.
A blue heart-shaped perfume bottle labeled YAGI sits on clear beads with other bottles blurred behind it.
A blonde woman lies on her side on blue beads with a white ribbon, looking directly at the camera.
A woman with closed eyes tilts her head while resting a blue heart-shaped perfume bottle against her cheek.
A woman in profile with closed eyes holds a blue heart-shaped YAGI perfume bottle near her lips.

look.lighting: Soft, even studio lighting with gentle specular highlights on glass and skin and minimal shadows.
look.palette: Cool blues across the bottles, beads, and backdrop, paired with white accents and warm skin tones.
look.texture: Clean and sharp on the subjects with shallow depth of field.

reading.summary: 5초 길이의 영상으로 총 5개의 장면으로 나뉘어 있어요. 카메라는 대부분 고정되어 있거나 천천히 회전하며 모델들과 파란색 하트 모양 향수병을 가까이에서 비춰요. 별도의 음악이나 말소리는 들리지 않아요.

montage.madeWith: Five quick shots, 0.0s–5.0s, soft blue studio light: a woman lies on white pearls among blue heart-shaped YAGI perfume bottles; the blue YAGI bottle on pearls in front of blurred bottles; a blonde woman lies on her side on pearls with a white ribbon; a dark-haired woman rests the bottle against her cheek, eyes closed; a woman with braided hair holds the bottle near her lips. Audio: no music.
